semantic_fields.positive_behavior: Canonical specification IDs and hashes are recomputed from every typed body and approval field, and identical semantics preserve the exact no-change decision.
semantic_fields.hostile_or_refusal_behavior: A copied hash cannot conceal forged typed body, scope, lineage, delta, timestamp, stable identity, or approval receipt semantics.

evidence_that_would_change: Any typed specification or approval field that can change while its canonical address remains valid would invalidate this proof.

semantic_fields.positive_behavior: An untouched content-addressed candidate preserves its complete planning iteration/pass timeline, semantic delta, authority impacts, and exact review token.
semantic_fields.hostile_or_refusal_behavior: Copied top-level hashes cannot conceal a nested delta, remaining-gap, assessment, stop, recommendation, or authority-impact mutation.

evidence_that_would_change: Any nested candidate field that can change without invalidating canonical addressing would reopen this boundary.

semantic_fields.positive_behavior: A verified real repository admits the public planning command and confines all runtime data and lock writes beneath that repository.
semantic_fields.hostile_or_refusal_behavior: Adjacent-prefix roots, empty or dot roots, intermediate symbolic links, and post-validation component swaps fail before outside-tree mutation.

evidence_that_would_change: A public Cobra process writing through an escaped or swapped repository component would invalidate containment.

semantic_fields.positive_behavior: Concurrent planning writers serialize beneath one repository lock and each successful planning iteration observes the exact predecessor state.
semantic_fields.hostile_or_refusal_behavior: A stale present, absent, delete, or held-session baseline refuses before any partial artifact or receipt publication.

evidence_that_would_change: A stale writer that publishes any target or two successful writers that observe the same predecessor would invalidate serialization.

semantic_fields.positive_behavior: An exact accepted plan starts one build transaction whose attempt, manifest, pointer, receipt, and dispatch authority commit as one unit.
semantic_fields.hostile_or_refusal_behavior: A stale authority, changed baseline, or semantically forged replay creates no attempt and authorizes no dispatch.

evidence_that_would_change: Any dispatch before the durable receipt or any conflicting replay mutation would invalidate atomic build start.

semantic_fields.positive_behavior: The exact current candidate accepts only before its immutable expiry while preserving one content-addressed acceptance authority.
semantic_fields.hostile_or_refusal_behavior: Acceptance at or after expiry and stale-before-expiry bindings refuse with typed standing facts and leave the active plan unchanged.

evidence_that_would_change: An acceptance at the exact deadline, a late acceptance receipt, or a changed active plan would invalidate this boundary.
